title: Listing hours and undercut hours columns
blurb: Two new Listings columns show when during the day an item's new listings appear and when it gets undercut, as a 24-hour strip in your time zone over the selected window. Sort either one by its busiest hour. The game never reports when a listing was posted, so listings are placed at the first upload that showed them; when an item gets too few uploads to place most listings within an hour, its strip is faded and the tooltip says so.
